name: Metformin 500 mg
precautions: Follow the prescription provided by your doctor.
Tell your healthcare professional about other medicines you take.
Discuss kidney problems with your healthcare professional.

condition_rules.message: This medicine is commonly used in diabetes management.
Kidney health can be relevant when this medicine is used; discuss kidney conditions with a healthcare professional.

name: Amlodipine 5 mg
uses: help manage certain types of chest pain
precautions: Follow the prescription provided by your doctor.
Tell your healthcare professional about other medicines you take.
Discuss persistent swelling or dizziness with a healthcare professional.

condition_rules.message: This medicine is commonly used to manage high blood pressure.

name: Paracetamol 500 mg
precautions: Follow the product label or physician's instructions.
Avoid taking multiple products containing the same active ingredient unless advised by a healthcare professional.
Discuss liver disease or heavy alcohol use with a healthcare professional.

condition_rules.message: Liver health is relevant when using this medicine; discuss liver disease with a healthcare professional.

name: Levothyroxine 50 mcg
precautions: Take the medicine exactly as prescribed.
Do not change the dose without medical advice.
Tell your healthcare professional about other medicines and supplements.

condition_rules.message: This medicine is used as thyroid hormone replacement in appropriate patients.
Heart conditions can be relevant when thyroid hormone treatment is used; discuss your history with a healthcare professional.

name: Atorvastatin 10 mg
uses: reduce cardiovascular risk in appropriate patients
precautions: Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness to a healthcare professional.
Discuss liver conditions and other medicines with your healthcare professional.

condition_rules.message: This medicine may be used as part of cardiovascular risk management in appropriate patients.
Liver health is relevant; discuss liver disease with a healthcare professional.
